```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# =============================================================================
# HELPER: takes a bind4 df, a state filter, an industry filter, a formula,
# a weight column, and returns avg_pct_diff
# =============================================================================

calc_pct_premium <- function(df, state_filter, ind_filter, ind_col, formula_rhs, weight_col) {

  if (state_filter == "ca")    df <- subset(df, state == 93)
  if (state_filter == "nonca") df <- subset(df, state != 93)

  if (ind_filter == "construction")    df <- subset(df, df[[ind_col]] == 4)
  if (ind_filter == "nonconstruction") df <- subset(df, df[[ind_col]] != 4)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NA)

  df$race   <- as.factor(df$wbho)
  df$county <- as.factor(df$fipscounty)
  df$educ_factor <- as.factor(df$educ)

  fmla  <- as.formula(paste("wage3 ~", formula_rhs))
  model <- tryCatch(
    lm(fmla, data = df, weights = df[[weight_col]]),
    error = function(e) { message("lm error: ", e$message); return(NULL) }
  )
  if (is.null(model)) return(NA)

  uw          <- subset(df, union == 1)
  if (nrow(uw) < 10) return(NA)
  hours       <- mean(uw$uhourse, na.rm = TRUE)
  cf          <- uw
  cf$union    <- 0
  pred_cf     <- predict(model, newdata = cf)

  actual <- uw$wage3 * uw$uhourse
  cfact  <- pred_cf  * uw$uhourse

  mean((actual - cfact) / cfact * 100, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# =============================================================================
# HELPER: weighted union density
# union == 1 among all workers (not just union) in the subset
# =============================================================================

calc_union_density <- function(df, state_filter, ind_filter, ind_col, weight_col) {

  if (state_filter == "ca")    df <- subset(df, state == 93)
  if (state_filter == "nonca") df <- subset(df, state != 93)

  if (ind_filter == "construction")    df <- subset(df, df[[ind_col]] == 4)
  if (ind_filter == "nonconstruction") df <- subset(df, df[[ind_col]] != 4)
  if (ind_filter == "all")             {}   # no industry filter

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NA)

  w        <- df[[weight_col]]
  is_union <- as.integer(df$union == 1)

  sum(w * is_union, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w[!is.na(is_union)], na.rm = TRUE) * 100
}

# =============================================================================
# Per-window settings
# =============================================================================

window_meta <- list(
  "2013-2017" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_1317", ind_col = "ind_2d",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ_factor + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "2008-2012" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_0812", ind_col = "ind_2d",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ_factor + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "2003-2007" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_0307", ind_col = "ind_2d",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ_factor + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "1998-2002" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_9802", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ_factor + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "1993-1997" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_9397", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ_factor + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "1988-1992" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_8892", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ_factor + race + female + married + year+race",
                     wt  = "fnlwgt"),
  "1983-1987" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_8387", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ_factor + female + married + year+race+married",
                     wt  = "fnlwgt")
)

period_order <- names(window_meta)

# =============================================================================
# CLEAR MEMORY
# =============================================================================

keep <- c(
  "cpsr_bind4_1317", "cpsr_bind4_0812", "cpsr_bind4_0307",
  "cpsr_bind4_9802", "cpsr_bind4_9397", "cpsr_bind4_8892", "cpsr_bind4_8387",
  "avg_pct_diff_1317", "avg_pct_diff_0812", "avg_pct_diff_0307",
  "avg_pct_diff_9802", "avg_pct_diff_9397", "avg_pct_diff_8892", "avg_pct_diff_8387",
  "window_meta", "calc_pct_premium", "calc_union_density", "period_order", "weeks_worked"
)

rm(list = setdiff(ls(), keep))
gc()

# =============================================================================
# LOOP — compute premium + density for each window
# =============================================================================

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(period_order, function(period) {
  meta <- window_meta[[period]]
  df   <- get(meta$df)

  # --- Union wage premium ---
  ca_con       <- calc_pct_premium(df, "ca",    "construction",    meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)
  nonca_con    <- calc_pct_premium(df, "nonca", "construction",    meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)
  ca_noncon    <- calc_pct_premium(df, "ca",    "nonconstruction", meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)
  nonca_noncon <- calc_pct_premium(df, "nonca", "nonconstruction", meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)

  # --- Union density ---
  den_ca_all      <- calc_union_density(df, "ca",    "all",          meta$ind_col, meta$wt)
  den_ca_con      <- calc_union_density(df, "ca",    "construction", meta$ind_col, meta$wt)
  den_nonca_all   <- calc_union_density(df, "nonca", "all",          meta$ind_col, meta$wt)
  den_nonca_con   <- calc_union_density(df, "nonca", "construction", meta$ind_col, meta$wt)

  data.frame(
    period           = period,
    ca_con           = ca_con,
    nonca_con        = nonca_con,
    ca_noncon        = ca_noncon,
    nonca_noncon     = nonca_noncon,
    den_ca_all       = den_ca_all,
    den_ca_con       = den_ca_con,
    den_nonca_all    = den_nonca_all,
    den_nonca_con    = den_nonca_con
  )
}))

results$period <- factor(results$period, levels = period_order)

# =============================================================================
# PLOT 2: Union density
# =============================================================================

density_long <- reshape(results,
  varying   = c("den_ca_all", "den_ca_con", "den_nonca_all", "den_nonca_con"),
  v.names   = "density",
  timevar   = "series",
  times     = c("CA All Industries", "CA Construction",
                "Non-CA All Industries", "Non-CA Construction"),
  direction = "long"
)
density_long$period <- factor(density_long$period, levels = period_order)

p_density <- ggplot(density_long, aes(x = period, y = density,
                                       color = series, group = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

  ) +

    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.caption     = element_text(hjust = 1)
  ) +

print(p_density)
```

```{r}
all_periods <- list(
  "1983-1987" = list(df = cpsr_bind4_8387, ind_col = "ind_nber", wt = "fnlwgt"),
  "1988-1992" = list(df = cpsr_bind4_8892, ind_col = "ind_nber", wt = "fnlwgt"),
  "1993-1997" = list(df = cpsr_bind4_9397, ind_col = "ind_nber", wt = "lonwgt"),
  "1998-2002" = list(df = cpsr_bind4_9802, ind_col = "ind_nber", wt = "lonwgt"),
  "2003-2007" = list(df = cpsr_bind4_0307, ind_col = "ind_2d",   wt = "lonwgt"),
  "2008-2012" = list(df = cpsr_bind4_0812, ind_col = "ind_2d",   wt = "lonwgt"),
  "2013-2017" = list(df = cpsr_bind4_1317, ind_col = "ind_2d",   wt = "lonwgt")
)

dist_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_periods), function(period) {
  meta <- all_periods[[period]]
  df   <- meta$df
 # df   <- subset(df, df[[meta$ind_col]] != 4)  # non-construction only

  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("California", "Rest of Country"), function(reg) {
    sub <- if (reg == "California") subset(df, state == 93) else subset(df, state != 93)
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)

    do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Union", "Non-Union"), function(ul) {
      s <- subset(sub, union == ifelse(ul == "Union", 1, 0))
      if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NULL)
      w <- s[[meta$wt]]

      # race
      race_tbl <- tapply(w, as.integer(s$wbho), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
      race_tbl <- race_tbl / sum(race_tbl, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
      race_df  <- data.frame(
        period      = period,
        region      = reg,
        union_label = ul,
        var         = "Race",
        category    = names(race_tbl),
        pct         = as.numeric(race_tbl)
      )

      # educ
      educ_tbl <- tapply(w, as.integer(s$educ), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
      educ_tbl <- educ_tbl / sum(educ_tbl, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
      educ_df  <- data.frame(
        period      = period,
        region      = reg,
        union_label = ul,
        var         = "Education",
        category    = names(educ_tbl),
        pct         = as.numeric(educ_tbl)
      )

      rbind(race_df, educ_df)
    }))
  }))
}))

dist_summary$period      <- factor(dist_summary$period, levels = names(all_periods))
dist_summary$union_label <- factor(dist_summary$union_label, levels = c("Union", "Non-Union"))


race_labels <- c("1" = "White", "2" = "Black", "3" = "Hispanic", "4" = "Other")
educ_labels <- c("1" = "Less than HS", "2" = "High School", "3" = "Some College",
                 "4" = "College", "5" = "Advanced")

race_df <- subset(dist_summary, var == "Race")
race_df <- subset(race_df, category %in% names(race_labels))
race_df$category_label <- factor(race_labels[race_df$category], levels = unname(race_labels))

educ_df <- subset(dist_summary, var == "Education")
educ_df <- subset(educ_df, category %in% names(educ_labels))
educ_df$category_label <- factor(educ_labels[educ_df$category], levels = unname(educ_labels))
```

```{r}
  summarise(avg_educ = weighted.mean(educ_num, pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
```

```{r}
dist_summary_con <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_periods), function(period) {
  meta <- all_periods[[period]]
  df   <- meta$df
  df   <- subset(df, df[[meta$ind_col]] == 4)  # construction only

  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("California", "Rest of Country"), function(reg) {
    sub <- if (reg == "California") subset(df, state == 93) else subset(df, state != 93)
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)

    do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Union", "Non-Union"), function(ul) {
      s <- subset(sub, union == ifelse(ul == "Union", 1, 0))
      if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NULL)
      w <- s[[meta$wt]]

      race_tbl <- tapply(w, as.integer(s$wbho), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
      race_tbl <- race_tbl[!is.na(race_tbl) & race_tbl > 0]
      if (length(race_tbl) == 0) return(NULL)
      race_tbl <- race_tbl / sum(race_tbl) * 100
      race_df  <- data.frame(period = period, region = reg, union_label = ul,
                             var = "Race", category = names(race_tbl),
                             pct = as.numeric(race_tbl), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

      educ_tbl <- tapply(w, as.integer(s$educ), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
      educ_tbl <- educ_tbl[!is.na(educ_tbl) & educ_tbl > 0]
      if (length(educ_tbl) == 0) return(NULL)
      educ_tbl <- educ_tbl / sum(educ_tbl) * 100
      educ_df  <- data.frame(period = period, region = reg, union_label = ul,
                             var = "Education", category = names(educ_tbl),
                             pct = as.numeric(educ_tbl), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

      rbind(race_df, educ_df)
    }))
  }))
}))

dist_summary_con$period      <- factor(dist_summary_con$period, levels = names(all_periods))
dist_summary_con$union_label <- factor(dist_summary_con$union_label, levels = c("Union", "Non-Union"))

race_df_con <- subset(dist_summary_con, var == "Race")
race_df_con <- subset(race_df_con, category %in% names(race_labels))
race_df_con$category_label <- factor(race_labels[race_df_con$category], levels = unname(race_labels))

educ_df_con <- subset(dist_summary_con, var == "Education")
educ_df_con <- subset(educ_df_con, category %in% names(educ_labels))
educ_df_con$category_label <- factor(educ_labels[educ_df_con$category], levels = unname(educ_labels))

# --- Race stacked bar ---
p_race_stack_con <- ggplot(race_df_con, aes(x = period, y = pct, fill = category_label)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(region ~ union_label) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = race_colors) +
  labs(
    title    = "Race Composition Over Time: Union vs. Non-Union",
    subtitle = "Construction workers only; share within group",
    x = NULL, y = "Share (%)", fill = NULL,
    caption  = "Source: CEPR ORG."
  ) +
  theme_union +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# --- Educ stacked bar ---
p_educ_stack_con <- ggplot(educ_df_con, aes(x = period, y = pct, fill = category_label)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(region ~ union_label) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = educ_colors) +
  labs(
    title    = "Education Composition Over Time: Union vs. Non-Union",
    subtitle = "Construction workers only; share within group",
    x = NULL, y = "Share (%)", fill = NULL,
    caption  = "Source: CEPR ORG."
  ) +
  theme_union +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_race_stack_con
p_educ_stack_con
```









```{r}
library(dplyr)

educ_wide_con <- educ_df_con %>%
  mutate(educ_num = as.integer(factor(category_label, levels = unname(educ_labels)))) %>%
  group_by(period, region, union_label) %>%
  summarise(avg_educ = weighted.mean(educ_num, pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = union_label, values_from = avg_educ) %>%
  mutate(union_gap = Union - `Non-Union`) %>%
  arrange(region, period)

print(educ_wide_con, n = Inf)

cat("\n--- California ---\n")
print(subset(educ_wide_con, region == "California")[, c("period", "Union", "Non-Union", "union_gap")])

cat("\n--- Rest of Country ---\n")
print(subset(educ_wide_con, region == "Rest of Country")[, c("period", "Union", "Non-Union", "union_gap")])
```
